verdict.rationale: Square provides a webhooks/event-notification system (square-docs-19, square-docs-20) that lets developers subscribe to events and trigger custom code, and mentions custom fraud rules/alerts (square-docs-28), but there is no built-in no-code rules engine for end-users to define arbitrary 'if event then action' automations — it requires external development to consume webhooks. Missing for 10: a native rules/automation builder UI, documented trigger-action templates, and evidence of AI-native rule definition beyond raw webhook infrastructure.
